# Command reference

## ddk

ddalggak — generates code from a design image, compares the rendered page with the design in a real browser, auto-fixes it, and certifies the result with evidence.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version` | `boolean` | `false` | Print the installed version. |
| `--log-level` | `str` | `"INFO"` | Log level |

## ddk apply

Write the generated files of a verified case into the repository.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--case-id` | `str` | `null` | Case ID to apply (default: latest) |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Target repository folder |
| `--dry-run` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the application plan without changing files |
| `--force` | `boolean` | `false` | Compatibility option: stop with export guidance |
| `--allow-blocked` | `boolean` | `false` | Compatibility option: stop with export guidance |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` | Print JSON |

## ddk audit

Check which clauses of the listed standards map to an artifact (a coverage check, not a certification).

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Target repository folder |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` | Print JSON |
| `--write` | `boolean` | `false` | Write benchmarks/compliance-matrix.json |
| `--strict` | `boolean` | `false` | Exit with code 1 when there is a gap |

## ddk change

Verify existing changes, inspect evidence, export, apply, or recover.

## ddk change apply

Apply an explicit ready run after confirming storage and editing conditions.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--case-id` | `str` | `required` | Case UUID. |
| `--run-id` | `str` | `required` | Ready run UUID. |
| `--run-sha256` | `str` | `required` | Complete run SHA256. |
| `--changes-sha256` | `str` | `required` | Changes SHA256. |
| `--apply-id` | `str` | `null` | Stable apply UUID; defaults to UUID v4. |
| `--required-assurance` | `str` | `"isolated"` | Required assurance: isolated or trusted-local. |
| `--confirm-local-storage` | `boolean` | `false` | Confirm local storage supports durable file replacement. |
| `--confirm-quiescence` | `boolean` | `false` | Confirm other writers and synchronization are stopped. |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Repository receiving the changes. |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` | Output one JSON result to stdout. |

| `--trusted-local` | `boolean` | `false` | Use host permissions; no OS isolation. Requires explicit approval. |
| `--project-inputs` | `path` | `null` |  |
| `--run-id` | `str` | `null` | Stable repair request UUID. |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` |  |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## ddk change verify

Check a fixed case against explicit baseline and candidate directories.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--baseline` | `path` | `null` | Baseline source directory. |
| `--git-base` | `str` | `null` | Immutable Git baseline ref. |
| `--candidate` | `path` | `null` | Candidate source directory; defaults to Git worktree. |
| `--case-file, --case` | `path` | `null` | Import this case definition file. |
| `--case-id` | `str` | `null` | Use an already imported case ID. |
| `--inputs` | `path` | `null` | Input directory for --case-file. |
| `--run-id` | `str` | `null` | Stable request UUID; defaults to UUID v4. |
| `--project-inputs` | `path` | `null` | JSON object mapping project paths to fixed input paths. |
| `--change-requirements` | `path` | `null` | JSON object mapping changed paths to requirement IDs. |
| `--trusted-local` | `boolean` | `false` | Explicitly approve project commands with host permissions and no OS isolation. |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Repository containing verified records. |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` | Output one JSON result to stdout. |

## ddk proof

Check the capability matrix against the evidence files on disk and print only the claims you may make. A claim is allowed only when its evidence exists and the gate conditions are met.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Target repository folder |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` | Print JSON |
| `--strict` | `boolean` | `false` | Exit with code 1 when the superset claim is not allowed |

## ddk report

Write the evidence report (one HTML page) of a saved case.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--case-id` | `str` | `null` | Case ID to report on (default: latest) |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Target repository folder |
| `--output, -o` | `path` | `null` | File to write (default: reports/report.html in the case folder) |
| `--open` | `boolean` | `false` | Open it in the default browser afterwards |

## ddk run

Run the whole loop on a design image: generate, build, compare in a browser, auto-fix, certify.

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image_paths` | `path` | `required` | Design image paths (one or more) |
| `--prompt, -p` | `str` | `"Implement the attached design as a responsive web page that follows the repository's existing framework, conventions and styling. Match the layout, spacing, typography and colours of the image as closely as possible."` | Instruction for the model (default: implement the image as it is) |
| `--repo` | `path` | `"."` | Target repository folder |
| `--case-id` | `str` | `null` | Case ID to use |
| `--json` | `boolean` | `false` | Print JSON |
| `--install` | `boolean` | `false` | Install dependencies in the disposable copy (--ignore-scripts); source dependencies are not copied |
| `--visual, --no-visual` | `boolean` | `null` | Compare the rendered page with the design image (default: on). --no-visual waives the comparison. |
| `--ssim-threshold` | `float range` | `null` | Minimum screenshot similarity (SSIM) to pass (default 0.92) |
| `--max-mismatch` | `float range` | `null` | Largest share of the page that may differ strongly from the design (default 0.03) |
